_comment: Merged by scripts/build_item_facts.py. PRICE: Serebii first, pokebase's `unlock` filling the ones Serebii prints as '??? VP'. TEXT: pokebase first, because its description is the mechanics and Serebii's is flavour. `source` and `text_source` say which answered.

Air Balloon.text: Causes the holder to float off the ground, making it immune to Ground-type moves, as well as the Spikes, Toxic Spikes, and Sticky Web statuses. Disappears for the duration of the battle if the holder takes damage from a move.
Air Balloon.serebii_text: An item to be held by a Pokémon. This balloon makes the holder float in the air. If the holder is hit with an attack, the balloon will burst.

Big Root.text: Boosts HP restored by draining moves and other HP-restoring effects by 30%.
Big Root.serebii_text: An item to be held by a Pokémon. This root boosts the amount of HP the holder restores to itself when it uses HP-stealing moves.

Binding Band.text: Increases the damage dealt to targets that have the Bound status. Targets will take damage equal to 1/6 of their max HP instead of 1/8 of their max HP.
Binding Band.serebii_text: An item to be held by a Pokémon. This band boosts the power of binding moves used by the holder.

Black Belt.text: Boosts the power of the holder's Fighting-type moves by 20%.
Black Belt.serebii_text: An item to be held by a Pokémon. This belt helps with focus and boosts the power of the holder's Fighting-type moves.

Black Glasses.text: Boosts the power of the holder's Dark-type moves by 20%.
Black Glasses.serebii_text: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It's a pair of shady- looking glasses that boost the power of the holder's Dark-type moves.

Bright Powder.text: Lowers the accuracy of moves targeting the holder by 10%.
Bright Powder.serebii_text: An item to be held by a Pokémon. This glittery powder casts a tricky glare that lowers the accuracy of opposing Pokémon's moves.

Charcoal.text: Boosts the power of the holder's Fire-type moves by 20%.
Charcoal.serebii_text: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It's a combustible fuel that boosts the power of the holder's Fire-type moves.

Choice Scarf.text: Boosts the holder's Speed by 50%, but it can only use the first move it selects until it switches out.
Choice Scarf.serebii_text: An item to be held by a Pokémon. This curious scarf boosts the holder's Speed stat but only allows the use of a single move.

Damp Rock.text: Rain summoned by the holder lasts 3 extra turns (8 turns total).
Damp Rock.serebii_text: An item to be held by a Pokémon. When the holder changes the weather to rain, the rain will persist for longer than usual.

Dragon Fang.text: Boosts the power of the holder's Dragon-type moves by 20%.
Dragon Fang.serebii_text: An item to be held by a Pokémon. This hard, sharp fang boosts the power of the holder's Dragon-type moves.

Eject Button.text: Switches the holder out of battle when the holder takes damage from a move. Disappears for the duration of the battle after a single use.
Eject Button.serebii_text: An item to be held by a Pokémon. If the holder is damaged by an attack, it will be switched out of battle to be replaced by another Pokémon on your team.

Electric Seed.text: Boosts the holder's Defense stat by 1 stage on Electric Terrain. Disappears for the duration of the battle after a single use.
Electric Seed.serebii_text: An item to be held by a Pokémon. If the terrain becomes Electric Terrain, the holder will use this seed to boost its own Defense stat.

Expert Belt.text: Boosts the power of the holder's supereffective moves by 20%.
Expert Belt.serebii_text: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It's a well-worn belt that slightly boosts the power of the holder's supereffective moves.

Fairy Feather.text: Boosts the power of the holder's Fairy-type moves by 20%.
Fairy Feather.serebii_text: An item to be held by a Pokémon. This feather, which gleams faintly when hit by light, boosts the power of the holder's Fairy-type moves.

Focus Band.text: If the holder would be knocked out by a move, it has a 10% chance to survive with 1 HP.
Focus Band.serebii_text: An item to be held by a Pokémon. When the holder is hit with a move that should knock it out, it may be able to endure with 1 HP.

Focus Sash.text: If the holder has full HP, it survives an otherwise fatal hit with 1 HP. Consumed after use.
Focus Sash.serebii_text: An item to be held by a Pokémon. If the holder has full HP and it is hit with a move that should knock it out, it will endure with 1 HP—but only once.

Grassy Seed.text: Boosts the holder's Defense stat by 1 stage on Grassy Terrain. Disappears for the duration of the battle after a single use.
Grassy Seed.serebii_text: An item to be held by a Pokémon. If the terrain becomes Grassy Terrain, the holder will use this seed to boost its own Defense stat.

Hard Stone.text: Boosts the power of the holder's Rock-type moves by 20%.
Hard Stone.serebii_text: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It's a durable stone that boosts the power of the holder's Rock-type moves.

Heat Rock.text: Harsh sunlight summoned by the holder lasts 3 extra turns (8 turns total).
Heat Rock.serebii_text: An item to be held by a Pokémon. When the holder changes the weather to harsh sunlight, the sunlight will persist for longer than usual.

Icy Rock.text: Snow summoned by the holder lasts 3 extra turns (8 turns total).
Icy Rock.serebii_text: An item to be held by a Pokémon. When the holder changes the weather to snow, the snow will persist for longer than usual.

Iron Ball.text: Halves the holder's Speed. If airborne, it becomes grounded, allowing Ground-type moves and entry hazards to affect it.
Iron Ball.serebii_text: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It lowers the holder's Speed stat and makes the holder vulnerable to Ground- type moves even if it is a Flying type or is levitating.

King's Rock.text: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It may cause the target to flinch whenever the holder successfully inflicts damage on them with an attack.
King's Rock.serebii_text: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It may cause the target to flinch whenever the holder successfully inflicts damage on them with an attack.

Leek.text: When held by a Farfetch'd or Sirfetch'd, gives the holder a 2-stage Critical-Hit Ratio Boost.
Leek.serebii_text: An item to be held by Farfetch'd or Sirfetch'd. This very long and stiff stalk of leek boosts the critical-hit ratio of their moves.

Leftovers.text: Restores 1/16 of the holder's max HP at the end of every turn.
Leftovers.serebii_text: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It slowly but steadily restores the holder's HP.

Life Orb.text: Boosts the power of the holder's moves by 30%, but the holder loses 10% of its max HP after using a damaging move.
Life Orb.serebii_text: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It boosts the power of the holder's moves, but the holder also loses a small amount of HP upon landing an attack.

Light Ball.text: Doubles the holder's Attack and Sp. Atk. if held by Pikachu.
Light Ball.serebii_text: An item to be held by Pikachu. It's a mysterious orb that boosts Pikachu's Attack and Sp. Atk stats.

Light Clay.text: Extends the duration of Light Screen, Reflect, and Aurora Veil by 3 turns (8 turns total).
Light Clay.serebii_text: An item to be held by a Pokémon. When the holder uses protective moves like Light Screen or Reflect, their effects will last longer than usual.

Magnet.text: Boosts the power of the holder's Electric-type moves by 20%.
Magnet.serebii_text: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It's a powerful magnet that boosts the power of the holder's Electric-type moves.

Mental Herb.text: Cures the holder of Infatuation, Taunt, Torment, Disable, Heal Block, and Encore. Consumed after use.
Mental Herb.serebii_text: An item to be held by a Pokémon. The holder will be able to shake off move-binding effects to move freely— but only once.

Metal Coat.text: Boosts the power of the holder's Steel-type moves by 20%.
Metal Coat.serebii_text: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It's a special metallic coating that boosts the power of the holder's Steel-type moves.

Metronome.text: Boosts the power of consecutive uses of the same move by 20% each time, up to 100%. The boost resets if a different move is used.
Metronome.serebii_text: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It boosts the power of a move that's used repeatedly. Once the chain is broken, the move's power returns to normal.

Miracle Seed.text: Boosts the power of the holder's Grass-type moves by 20%.
Miracle Seed.serebii_text: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It's a seed imbued with life force that boosts the power of the holder's Grass-type moves.

Misty Seed.text: Boosts the holder's Sp. Def stat by 1 stage on Misty Terrain. Disappears for the duration of the battle after a single use.
Misty Seed.serebii_text: An item to be held by a Pokémon. If the terrain becomes Misty Terrain, the holder will use this seed to boost its own Sp. Def stat.

Muscle Band.text: Boosts the power of the holder's physical moves by 10%.
Muscle Band.serebii_text: An item to be held by a Pokémon. This headband exudes strength, slightly boosting the power of the holder's physical moves.

Mystic Water.text: Boosts the power of the holder's Water-type moves by 20%.
Mystic Water.serebii_text: An item to be held by a Pokémon. This teardrop-shaped gem boosts the power of the holder's Water-type moves.

Never-Melt Ice.text: Boosts the power of the holder's Ice-type moves by 20%.
Never-Melt Ice.serebii_text: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It's a heat-repelling piece of ice that boosts the power of the holder's Ice- type moves.

Normal Gem.text: Boosts the power of the holder's Normal-type moves by 30%. Disappears for the duration of the battle after a single use.
Normal Gem.serebii_text: An item to be held by a Pokémon. This gem is imbued with the essence of normalcy and will boost the power of a Normal-type move—but only once.

Poison Barb.text: Boosts the power of the holder's Poison-type moves by 20%.
Poison Barb.serebii_text: An item to be held by a Pokémon. This small poisonous barb boosts the power of the holder's Poison-type moves.

Psychic Seed.text: Boosts the holder's Sp. Def stat by 1 stage on Psychic Terrain. Disappears for the duration of the battle after a single use.
Psychic Seed.serebii_text: An item to be held by a Pokémon. If the terrain becomes Psychic Terrain, the holder will use this seed to boost its own Sp. Def stat.

Quick Claw.text: Gives the holder's moves a 20% chance to go first against moves with the same priority.
Quick Claw.serebii_text: An item to be held by a Pokémon. This light, sharp claw lets the holder occasionally unleash a move faster than it usually would.

Red Card.text: When the holder takes damage from a move, the attacker is forced to switch out of battle. Disappears for the duration of the battle after a single use.
Red Card.serebii_text: An item to be held by a Pokémon. If the holder is damaged by an attack, the mysterious power of this card can remove the attacker from the battle.

Rocky Helmet.text: When the holder is hit by a contact move, the attacker takes damage equal to 1/6 of its max HP.
Rocky Helmet.serebii_text: An item to be held by a Pokémon. This helmet damages any attacker that makes direct contact with the holder.

Scope Lens.text: Raises the holder's critical-hit ratio by 1 stage.
Scope Lens.serebii_text: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It's a lens for scoping out weak points. It boosts the holder's critical-hit ratio.

Sharp Beak.text: Boosts the power of the holder's Flying-type moves by 20%.
Sharp Beak.serebii_text: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It's a long, sharp beak that boosts the power of the holder's Flying-type moves.

Shed Shell.text: Allows the holder to switch out even if prevented by a move or Ability.
Shed Shell.serebii_text: An item to be held by a Pokémon. Hard and sturdy, this discarded carapace enables the holder to switch out of battle without fail.

Shell Bell.text: Restores HP equal to 1/8 of the damage dealt by the holder's damaging moves.
Shell Bell.serebii_text: An item to be held by a Pokémon. The holder restores a little HP to itself every time it inflicts damage with an attack.

Silk Scarf.text: Boosts the power of the holder's Normal-type moves by 20%.
Silk Scarf.serebii_text: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It's a sumptuous scarf that boosts the power of the holder's Normal-type moves.

Silver Powder.text: Boosts the power of the holder's Bug-type moves by 20%.
Silver Powder.serebii_text: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It's a shiny silver powder that boosts the power of the holder's Bug-type moves.

Smooth Rock.text: Sandstorm summoned by the holder lasts 3 extra turns (8 turns total).
Smooth Rock.serebii_text: An item to be held by a Pokémon. When the holder changes the weather to a sandstorm, the storm will persist for longer than usual.

Soft Sand.text: Boosts the power of the holder's Ground-type moves by 20%.
Soft Sand.serebii_text: An item to be held by a Pokémon. This loose, silky sand boosts the power of the holder's Ground-type moves.

Spell Tag.text: Boosts the power of the holder's Ghost-type moves by 20%.
Spell Tag.serebii_text: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It's a sinister, eerie tag that boosts the power of the holder's Ghost-type moves.

Terrain Extender.text: When the holder creates terrain with its moves or Ability, the duration is extended by 3 turns. (Total duration: 8 turns)
Terrain Extender.serebii_text: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It extends the duration of terrain caused by the holder's move or Ability.

Twisted Spoon.text: Boosts the power of the holder's Psychic-type moves by 20%.
Twisted Spoon.serebii_text: An item to be held by a Pokémon. This spoon is imbued with telekinetic energy and boosts the power of the holder's Psychic-type moves.

White Herb.text: Restores the holder's lowered stats to normal. Consumed after use.
White Herb.serebii_text: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It will restore any lowered stat in battle—but only once.

Wide Lens.text: Boosts the accuracy of the holder's moves by 10%.
Wide Lens.serebii_text: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It's a magnifying lens that slightly boosts the accuracy of the holder's moves.

Wise Glasses.text: Boosts the power of the holder's special moves by 10%.
Wise Glasses.serebii_text: An item to be held by a Pokémon. This thick pair of glasses slightly boosts the power of the holder's special moves.

Zoom Lens.text: Boosts the accuracy of the holder's moves by 20% when it moves after the target.
Zoom Lens.serebii_text: An item to be held by a Pokémon. When the holder acts after its target, its move will be more accurate than usual.
